dict.string: Dictionaries under GPL-3.0-or-later (FreeDict, GCIDE; FreeDict also under AGPL-3.0-or-later, which upstream applies to the ding2tei-haskell part of its combined work) are distributed as compiled .mdx files. Their corresponding source — the conversion scripts and the upstream source archives (freedict-eng-deu.src.tar.xz, freedict-deu-eng.src.tar.xz, gcide-0.53.tar.xz) — is published at https://github.com/naco-siren/OpenMDict-dictionary-sources, one tag for each set of shipped files; make there rebuilds each file byte for byte. FreeDict's own source form is the Ding dictionary (GPLv2+) and ding2tei-haskell (AGPLv3+), which its TEI header names. The description of each of these dictionaries links the repository.
